data.gender_notes: Halina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word ‘haliti’, meaning ‘to comfort’ or ‘to console’. This name is often given to a baby girl born in the summer, symbolizing the beauty and grace of nature during this season. The name Halina carries the meaning “Beautiful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Halina usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Halina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Halina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Χαλίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χαλίνη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό ρήμα 'χαλίνω', που σημαίνει 'καταπτοώ' ή 'ηρεμώ'. Στον χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το Χαλίνη συμβολίζει την ηρεμία και την γαλήνη που προσφέρει ο Θεός στους πιστούς του.

in_latin.name: Halina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Halina originem habet in voce Latina 'lux', quae significat 'lumen'. In traditione christiana, nomen Halina refertur ad lumen divinum quod Deus praebet fidelibus suis.
